intro: Lesson 45: Section A exam questions: 1.1 to 1.5. To understand how to answer Section A questions on the Prophet's ﷺ life from early years to the Sunnah

questions.q: Explain two reasons why the Prophet's ﷺ early life mattered for his later work. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: His honesty (al-Amin) made people trust his message; his work as a trader and with Khadijah gave experience and support.
questions.model: Point 1: his honesty prepared people to trust him. Develop: called al-Amin, so the Quraysh could not call him a liar. Point 2: experience in trade and society. Develop: travel and business with Khadijah's support, who later believed first.
